$50B for rural hospitals sounds noble, but let’s unpack the Working Families Tax Cut’s Rural Health Transformation Fund. The bill allocates half the funds equally to states regardless of rural population size—meaning Connecticut’s 3 rural hospitals could get the same cut as Kansas’ 90. CMS’s vague criteria for the remaining $25B opens the door to bureaucratic favoritism, not need-based distribution.

Meanwhile, Medicaid faces $911B in cuts—this fund offsets just 5% of that. Classic D.C.: throw cash at a headline without fixing systemic bloat.

Rural healthcare needs targeted reform, not another slush fund for states to mismanage.

Now Democrats want to take this funding away to provide Medicaid to illegal aliens with YOUR money!
